title: Amir Khusrau
summary: Poet, writer and musician, born in 1253 at Patiali to a Turkic-speaking father and an Indian mother. He lived in Delhi through a succession of sultans and served as poet at the courts of several of them. A disciple of the Sufi teacher Nizamuddin Auliya, he died in 1325 and is buried in Delhi's Nizamuddin Dargah complex.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com gives 1253 to 1325 for the lifespan; Live History India says he lived between 1253 and 1325 CE. Neither page gives a birth or death day.

where.modern_name: Nizamuddin Dargah, Delhi, India (pinned to his tomb, where he is buried beside his teacher; he was born at Patiali, Uttar Pradesh)
where.historical_name: Delhi, capital of the Delhi Sultanate; the khanqah of Nizamuddin Auliya

importance.justification: Encyclopedia.com calls him an important poet, writer and musician of his era, and Live History India says he was poet laureate at the courts of five sultans.
